name: pr-body
title: PR Body
summary: Write PR bodies with the smallest clarifying visual, before/after evidence, and an honest call on what merging risks, including explicit verification gaps when proof is not authorized.

use_when: Creating or updating a pull request description
A finished change is about to be opened for review
avoid_when: Reviewing a PR's content — use pr-review
Planning commits, branches, or history — use git-workflow
The PR is one layer of a stack — use gh-stack for the stack
